compiled_state.description:
## Why
The additive model and its back-compat/lifecycle invariants must be locked by tests.
## What
Cover all invariants end to end (integration tests require all prior children merged).
## Scope
`tests/interfaces/lifecycle/` (coexistence, reopen validity), reducer/compaction unit tests,
`tests/unit/test_signing.py`.
## Depends on
Requires 114f, 2c2d, cc1b, 929e merged (integration over the full surface).
## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test: plan-review + close retains both kinds; re-sign a kind replaces in place.
- [ ] Test: compaction/SNAPSHOT round-trip preserves all kinds.
- [ ] Test: legacy single-signature ticket reads/verifies via fold-in; a NEW snapshot is readable by old-code (mirror present).
- [ ] Test: reopen makes completion (and plan-review) read not-valid; records unchanged; re-close re-signs.
- [ ] Test: a material-field edit after signing invalidates completion validity; a tag/assignee edit does NOT.
- [ ] Test: concurrent different-kind signs both survive (per-key LWW convergence).
- [ ] Test: no HMAC hex appears in `show`/MCP public output for any attestation kind.
compiled_state.title: Tests: coexistence, compaction, legacy read, reopen validity
